rule: If two measured runs with different max-steps produce the same failing mutations (same reason=max_steps, same score), further blanket step increases are low-value. Switch hypothesis to diagnosis quality, tool selection order, or repair prompt. Design the smallest experiment that tests the new hypothesis. Do NOT auto-enqueue the same diagnosis job in a loop — one diagnosis per hypothesis, then inspect the trace.
